big: Nifty Realty is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Realty track?
Nifty Realty Index is designed to reflect the behaviour and performance of Real Estate companies. It holds 10 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
note: P/E is price relative to earnings. A higher P/E means investors pay more for each rupee of earnings.
